title: jired link / unlink result
description: Links staged onto issues as `links:` lines, or taken off them

links.description: The links named on the command line: an issue link as its direction and key (an empty direction, for unlink, means any), a web link as its URL and title

issues.description: One entry per issue whose file was written

changed.description: False when the issue already had (for unlink: did not have) every link named

staged.description: Whether the change is written in the files and waiting for `jired push`. True without `--push`, with `--dry-run`, and when the push failed.

next.description: The command that sends what is staged, when anything is.

push.description: A jired/push/1 document when --push was given
